headline: Samsung's Galaxy AI: Which Tools Actually Save Time? Tested on S24 Ultra
summary: An in-depth review of Samsung's AI features across Notes, Voice Recorder, Gallery, and more, revealing which tools are genuinely useful and which are just gimmicks.
details: Samsung has packed a multitude of AI tools into its Galaxy devices, but keeping track of them all is a challenge. This review tests every AI feature on the S24 Ultra to determine their real-world utility, categorizing them as time-savers, requiring a double-check, or outright gimmicks.

In Samsung Notes, the 'Meeting notes' auto-format feature proved highly effective, correctly organizing text with participants, topics, decisions, and action items. However, the 'Headers and bullets' feature was deemed a gimmick, failing to provide meaningful organization.

The 'Summarize' tool in Notes, available in Standard and Detailed modes, successfully condensed notes without omitting crucial details like specific numbers or responsibilities. This feature is a clear time-saver for managing information.

Samsung's Voice Recorder includes transcription and summarization tools. While the transcription can be error-prone, especially in noisy environments or with rapid speech, the 'action buttons' under the summary can quickly add events to your calendar.

The Voice Recorder's 'Summarize' tool, even with a near-perfect transcript, sometimes omitted key details or added fabricated information. Translations, which rely on the same transcriptions, also suffered from errors, merging sentences due to missing punctuation.

Samsung Gallery's 'Generative Edit' offers powerful tools like AI eraser, Move, and Create. The AI eraser flawlessly removed an object without smudges, and the 'Create' tool successfully swapped an object and repainted phones. However, the 'Move' function altered an object's proportions and added unintended details.

Instant slow-mo in the Gallery app provides a quick way to slow down videos by pressing and holding them, though occasional stuttering can occur. 'FanCam' tracks a chosen subject, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the original video framing.

AI suggestions in Gallery, such as 'Erase reflections' and 'Erase shadows,' had mixed results. 'Erase reflections' failed to remove light spots, while 'Erase shadows' required multiple attempts but eventually cleaned up a shadow on a handwritten page.

Circle to Search, a Google feature integrated into Galaxy AI, allows users to search for anything on their screen by circling, tapping, or scribbling. It also offers the capability to copy or translate on-screen text.

topic: troubleshooting airpods and galaxy watch issues
headline: AirPods Disconnecting? Fix Automatic Switching Settings
summary: If your AirPods keep dropping connection, it might not be the buds themselves. Learn how to adjust settings to prevent unwanted switching between devices.
details: Bothered by AirPods disconnecting unexpectedly? Before you assume your earbuds are faulty, check the automatic switching feature. This setting, available on AirPods Pro, AirPods Max, and AirPods 2 or later, can cause your AirPods to jump between your iPhone, iPad, and Mac, leading to perceived disconnections.

To regain control, you need to adjust the 'Connect to this iPhone/iPad/Mac' setting. On your iPhone or iPad, navigate to Settings > [Your AirPods Name] > Audio & Routing and select 'When Last Connected to This iPhone/iPad'. Repeat this on your Mac via Settings > Bluetooth > [Your AirPods Name] > Connect to This [Device] > When Last Connected to This [Device].

If you primarily use your AirPods with one device, keep the 'Automatic' setting there and switch to 'When Last Connected' on your secondary devices. This ensures they connect to your main device automatically but won't switch unless you manually select them on others. For devices you rarely use, consider using 'Forget This Device' in the Bluetooth menu to prevent any accidental connections.

Another common culprit is the 'Automatic Ear Detection' feature. If the sensors misbehave or your AirPods don't have a proper seal, they might pause playback unexpectedly. Ensure your AirPods fit snugly by running the 'Ear Tip Fit Test' in the AirPods settings. Clean your earbuds and case regularly to maintain proper contact and charging.

If the issue persists, you can disable 'Automatic Ear Detection' in the same AirPods settings menu under Audio & Routing. If disconnections continue, check for network issues affecting streaming audio or potential interference from microwaves, heavy Wi-Fi, or other Bluetooth devices. Even Siri's activation can sometimes interrupt playback, so consider disabling 'Requests' for Siri if necessary.
